description: In the heart of Vienna, a series of art thefts have left the city in turmoil. As whispers of a notorious art thief circulate, you must navigate the intricate web of deception and misdirection to uncover the true identity of the mastermind behind these crimes. Each suspect presents a façade, but only one holds the key to the truth. Can you decipher the clues hidden in their stories and catch the elusive thief before they vanish into the night?

reasoning_chain: Elena Novak is the only female suspect with red hair and a favorite food of Schnitzel.
Her hobby of photography aligns with the clues about observing and capturing art.
The other suspects have conflicting traits that do not match the clues provided.

solution: Connect the clues about the red-haired woman with a passion for photography and her favorite food to identify Elena Novak as the thief.
